bagPolicy.summary: All bags, including purses and fanny packs, are prohibited. One appropriately sized bag is allowed for a guest with medical or childcare needs after it is inspected and tagged at an entrance solutions table.
allowed: One inspected medical- or childcare-necessity bag
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The A–Z guide links separate parking instructions for men’s basketball and other Crisler Center events; lots and permit requirements vary by event.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue has not published specific rideshare guidance on its official venue or guest-information pages.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Full-service concession stands operate around the concourse, and transactions are cashless and contactless.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The northeast-entrance elevator provides access between arena areas for guests with accessibility needs. Accessible seating exchanges and designated parking are available under the venue guide.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The A–Z guide lists exit and re-entry rules for Crisler Center; standard event entry does not permit unrestricted re-entry.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Public will call is at the Northeast Entrance. Guests parking inside the stadium concourse can follow the accessible south-side path to that entrance.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Gates open 60 minutes before tipoff. The northeast entrance serves general admission, accessible entry, public will call, and designated pass lists; the northwest entrance is student-only.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
